text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1073, Sea Scallop Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

The Nickel Silver Sea Scallop Door Knocker is made with the attention to detail that one would expect from Michael Healy Designs. Every ridge of the seashell was first sculpted into a model to make the sandcast mold. The Micheal Healy MH1073 front door knocker has a nickel silver finish, which is achieved by giving the piece a nickel plating to make its warm silver color. It is a unique finish that combines a polished finish with brushed accents. The Sea Scallop Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver comes packaged with mounting hardware. This premium door knocker is the perfect finishing touch for any beach side getaway.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass with Brown Patina Oiled Bronze

Also Available: smaller 4" Nickel Silver Bay Scallop Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Nickel Silver Sea Scallop Premium Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 5-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
